label: FP
reason: The user-controlled input is sanitized in doSomething() by truncating the parameter to length minus one, effectively removing the last character. This prevents direct injection into format strings. The sink uses formatString with bar, which is derived from param after sanitization, so no cross-site scripting vulnerability exists.

evidence.note: The param is truncated to remove the last character, preventing untrusted input from reaching the sink.
